title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct SXU study environments, from library rooms to residence-hall and Warde Academic Center spaces.

cards.entity_name: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.title: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center, L-228
cards.notes: Start here when you need research tools close at hand: use the desktop computers, scanners, printers, and librarian assistance for a project work session.
cards.short_summary: A full-service library workspace with research help and equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says the library has desktop computers, printers, scanners, quiet and group study rooms, and staff research assistance.
cards.source_title: Robert and Mary Rita Murphy Stump Library | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: No food is allowed in the library; drinks with covers are permitted. Check the library website for current hours.

cards.title: Stump Library Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Inside Stump Library, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Bring a covered drink and settle into the library’s main quiet-study area for reading, drafting, or other work that benefits from a lower-distraction setting.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies a main Quiet Study Area in its library and notes that covered drinks are permitted while food is not.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: Located in Stump Library. No food; covered drinks are permitted. Consult library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Stump Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Upper level of Stump Library
cards.notes: Use one of the upstairs group rooms when your assignment needs conversation: coordinate with your group first and check room availability through SXU reservations.
cards.short_summary: Upstairs library rooms designed for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s parent guide states that Stump Library has 10 group study rooms upstairs; its campus map identifies Library Group Study Rooms.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: SXU directs users to Room Reservations to check study-space availability; verify date and availability before going.

cards.title: Stump Library Lower-Level Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Stump Library
cards.notes: Choose a lower-level study room for a smaller work session, then use the nearby library stacks to pull print materials as your research takes shape.
cards.short_summary: Three study rooms adjacent to the library’s lower-level stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that Stump Library has three study rooms on its lower level; the Warde map labels the lower-level Library Stacks.
cards.source_title: Parent A to Z Guide and Information | Saint Xavier University
cards.access_notes: Use SXU Room Reservations to check availability. Library food and drink rules apply.

cards.title: The Link
cards.subtitle: Second-floor connection between McCarthy and Rubloff Halls
cards.notes: Read or review notes in this second-floor connector overlooking Schmidt Quad; if you live elsewhere on campus, sign in at the Rubloff front desk first.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading and study connector with a quad view.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes The Link as a quiet study or reading space between McCarthy and Rubloff Halls that overlooks Schmidt Quad.
cards.access_notes: Designed for residents. Residents not living in Rubloff or McCarthy may access it by signing in at the Rubloff Hall front desk.

cards.title: Morris Hall 24/7 Student Room
cards.subtitle: Morris Hall
cards.notes: Use this around-the-clock student room when you need campus internet and University services from a residence-hall setting; bring your own study materials.
cards.short_summary: A Morris Hall student room with 24/7 internet access.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that students can connect to the internet and other University services in Morris Hall’s 24/7 Student Room.
cards.access_notes: SXU describes the room as 24/7; confirm residence-hall access requirements with Residence Life.

cards.title: Pacelli Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Each floor of Pacelli Hall
cards.notes: Pick the floor lounge nearest your room for an informal study block; each study lounge includes a microwave, useful when you plan a longer session.
cards.short_summary: Residence-hall study lounges available on every Pacelli floor.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU lists study lounges on each floor of Pacelli Hall and says they include microwaves.
cards.access_notes: Located within Pacelli Hall; confirm residence-hall guest and building-access rules with Residence Life.

cards.title: Warde Academic Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: First floor, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Use the atrium as a central meeting point before class, then spread out for coursework near the building’s library, computer labs, lounges, and support offices.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Warde gathering space among academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s Warde Academic Center map labels an Atrium, and SXU describes Warde as a primary location for studying with library, lounges, and computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Located in Warde Academic Center. Consult SXU building access information and event schedules before planning a session.

cards.title: Wiseman Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: L-105, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Set up in this named Warde lounge for a campus-based work block, then move easily to nearby student support, computer lab, library, or classroom resources.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student lounge in the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s current Warde Academic Center map labels the Wiseman Student Lounge as L-105.
cards.access_notes: L-105 in Warde Academic Center. Check building access and any scheduled use before relying on the lounge.

cards.title: Warde Academic Center Outdoor Seating
cards.subtitle: First-floor outdoor seating, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Take reading or a laptop outside at the map-listed seating area when weather permits, with Warde’s library, computer labs, and student resources close by.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor option beside Warde’s academic amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU’s current Warde Academic Center map labels Outdoor Seating, and SXU describes Warde as a location for studying with library and computer-lab resources.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather and campus conditions; use Warde’s indoor spaces as an alternative.
